name: gantt-chart
title: Gantt chart
description: A project-plan timeline: a pinned task list with host-defined columns beside a scrollable day/week/month timeline of bars, milestones and roll-up summary brackets, with typed dependency arrows (finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish) carrying lag, critical-path highlighting, drag-to-link, quick-create on empty lanes, a today marker, weekend shading, collapsible groups, and rescheduling by drag, edge-drag resizing or keyboard chords behind a confirmable move gate with an optional dependent cascade.
